title: UI Component Package Profile v1
summary: A reusable UI component package with tokens, components, examples, accessibility, visual checks, and integration surfaces.

integration_points.name: component_api
integration_points.description: Props, variants, states, events, slots, and examples.

integration_points.name: accessibility
integration_points.description: Keyboard, focus, semantics, contrast, announcements, and motion constraints.

integration_points.name: visual_verification
integration_points.description: Baselines, fixtures, states, tolerances, and artifacts.

checks: Components declare props, variants, states, events, accessibility, and examples.
Design tokens and assets are discoverable.
Breaking visual or API changes include migration notes.
Accessibility expectations are represented as testable constraints.
Build and validation commands are declared.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for reusable component libraries and design systems.
Keep implementation framework-specific, but keep component API and states portable.
Report changed components, variants, accessibility expectations, and visual checks.
